Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 5.3, 6.2; courts F/G. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: post-M1 / extended capability.
Integration parent: bd-01M1C2TVQTHW3KSESS9M0ET168; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: bd-01M35A7AZQZ4H1ZA7FEXHD0K21.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Own neutral ordinal/target-range navigator and overview/detail viewport controls over the same checked inventory. Use distinct individual marks only when device resolution permits. Reuse shared column transform and exact matrix; no statistical downsampling or scientific aggregation in Atlas.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. All 84 IDs are represented once in resolvable overview, with untimed ambiguous, failed and all-external rows reachable; readable detail keeps normal row/text size.
2. When 524 by 1000 cannot fit, report all units indexed and exact displayed ranges; range blocks are neutral and open a range for explicit unit selection.
3. Reveal selected/target, whole story, horizontal range controls and keyboard equivalents move viewport without changing result, cut, values or focus.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
Use exact paged/range map and table; never claim all individual rows visible when sampled or pixel-blended.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.
set.title: [Scale] Add full-inventory navigator and readable matrix range controls
